title: Evaluate individual feature additions, combinations and ablations on human feedback
description: Replacement protocol after sample-size review: evaluate independently scheduled example selection, rubric refinement and question measurement; do not combine them as one winner-selection cycle. New question measurement freezes active rubric/example list/existing questions and retrospectively backfills complete augmented requests over eligible reviewed items, default configurable cap200. Freeze window/cutoff/selection policy, feedback roles and revisions, context versions, question definitions, model and request budgets. Rank candidates on a matched window using human final labels, not merely model main-answer agreement; supporting answers are model features, not their own human ground truth. Direct agreement requires matching semantics; otherwise class-conditional probabilities and out-of-fold learned final-label mapping with inverse/multiclass relationships. Show actual N/per-class counts, majority baseline, natural and balanced alignment, coverage/uncertainty; distinguish training association from cross-validated rank and fresh holdout accuracy. Preserve protected audit/scoreboard roles and target-label/comment exclusion. Retrospective ranks do not automatically promote a classifier. Old four-item comparisons are execution evidence/hypotheses, not credible improvement claims. Retain feature/revision history and rerun as feedback/context grows. Core issue 1baadb68 owns reusable stage/backfill/ranking mechanisms; this repository freezes protocols and reports results. Combination/ablation experiments follow the new staged feature matrix. No DSPy, no second flywheel implementation, no paid calls merely from recording the plan.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Core single-feature milestone is implemented and verified with 427 offline specs. Each proposed supporting question is now admitted independently, fitted against a common incumbent with other questions/rubric/examples fixed, and retained with training-signal diagnostics and development results. Individual-feature experiment preflight on the frozen 87-vote snapshot permits up to five isolated fits, with ceiling 373 Jev / 3 GPT-6 Luna calls; one-feature limit permits three fits and ceiling 227 / 3. No new paid calls or new performance result yet. Existing grouped-question experiment is historical evidence only. Next evaluation must freeze the new protocol and collect individual trials without leaking protected feedback. Combinations and ablations remain deferred until this path is validated live.
